description: Monthly payroll employer cost must equal ledger salary-related expense (5001-5005).
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT month, p.cost - l.exp AS diff FROM payroll p JOIN ledger l USING(month) WHERE ABS(diff) > 0.01
fix_guidance: Check the payroll posting entry for that run

description: Total debits equal total credits per journal entry.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT entry_id FROM fact_ledger GROUP BY entry_id HAVING ABS(SUM(debit) - SUM(credit)) > 0.005
fix_guidance: Reject the entry and alert the ledger owner

description: One payroll row per employee per run.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT employee_id, run_id FROM fact_payroll GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
fix_guidance: Remove duplicate and trace its source

description: Every fact employee_id exists in dim_employee.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT f.employee_id FROM fact_payroll f LEFT JOIN dim_employee d USING(employee_id) WHERE d.employee_id IS NULL
fix_guidance: Fix the key or load the missing employee

description: Attendance month must not be after the employee exit month.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT a.* FROM fact_attendance a JOIN dim_employee d ON a.employee_id = d.employee_id AND d.is_current = 'Y' WHERE d.exit_date IS NOT NULL AND a.period_end_date > LAST_DAY(d.exit_date)
fix_guidance: Ask HR to confirm exit date or remove the row

description: Employees with unpaid absence days in attendance must show lop_days in payroll for the month.
logic_sql_or_rule: Compare fact_attendance.unpaid_absence_days with fact_payroll.lop_days per employee-month

description: Invoice paid must not exceed total; balance must not be negative.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT invoice_id FROM fact_invoice WHERE amount_paid > total_amount OR balance_due < 0

description: Total must equal amount plus GST.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT expense_id FROM fact_expense WHERE ABS(total_amount - (amount_excl_gst + gst_amount)) > 0.01

description: Completed date not before started date; Done tasks have a completed date.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT task_id FROM fact_task WHERE completed_date < started_date OR (status = 'Done' AND completed_date IS NULL)
fix_guidance: Ask the team to fix the board data

description: Leave end date not before start date.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT leave_request_id FROM fact_leave WHERE end_date < start_date

description: Prediction as-of dates within 7 days of the batch date; scored_at within 24 hours of load.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT prediction_id FROM fact_attrition_risk WHERE as_of_date < (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM fact_attrition_risk) - 7
fix_guidance: Ask the AI team to rerun scoring

description: Employee versions must not overlap in time.
logic_sql_or_rule: SELECT a.employee_key FROM dim_employee a JOIN dim_employee b ON a.employee_id = b.employee_id AND a.employee_key < b.employee_key AND a.valid_to >= b.valid_from
fix_guidance: Close the earlier version the day before the next one starts

description: Aggregates shown to managers must cover at least the minimum group size in the metric dictionary.
fix_guidance: Suppress the cell or combine groups
